mapper.sql: t.id, t.enterprise_id, e.name AS enterprise_name, t.source, t.mode, t.interval_minutes, t.max_pages, t.enabled, t.next_run_at, t.last_status, t.last_finished_at, t.consecutive_failures, t.created_at, t.updated_at, c.last_success_at, c.last_pages_fetched, c.possibly_truncated, CASE WHEN t.lease_token IS NOT NULL AND t.lease_until >= NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS running, (SELECT r.error_code FROM collector_monitor_run r WHERE r.task_id = t.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_error_code
FROM collector_monitor_task t JOIN ent_enterprise e ON e.id = t.enterprise_id LEFT JOIN collector_monitor_cursor c ON c.task_id = t.id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN enabled = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN last_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_until >= NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS running FROM collector_monitor_task
SELECT ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, lease_token, lease_until FROM collector_monitor_task WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collector_monitor_task(enterprise_id, source, mode, interval_minutes, max_pages, enabled, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{enterprise}, 'QCC', #{mode}, #{intervalMinutes}, #{maxPages}, FALSE, #{actor}, #{actor})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.enterprise_id, e.name AS enterprise_name, e.uscc, t.mode, t.max_pages, t.lease_token FROM collector_monitor_task t JOIN ent_enterprise e ON e.id = t.enterprise_id WHERE t.enabled = TRUE AND t.next_run_at <= NOW() AND (t.lease_until IS NULL OR t.lease_until < NOW()) ORDER BY t.next_run_at, t.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE collector_monitor_run SET status = 'ABANDONED', finished_at = NOW() WHERE lease_token = #{token} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE collector_monitor_task SET lease_token = #{token}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collector_monitor_run(task_id, lease_token, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{token}, 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE collector_monitor_task SET enabled = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'FAILED' AND consecutive_failures + 1 >= 3 THEN FALSE ELSE enabled END, consecutive_failures = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'FAILED' THEN consecutive_failures + 1 ELSE 0 END, next_run_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL (CASE WHEN #{status} = 'FAILED' THEN 60 ELSE interval_minutes END) MINUTE), last_status = #{status}, last_finished_at = NOW(), lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_token = #{token} AND lease_until >= NOW()

UPDATE collector_monitor_run SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, created_records = #{created}, updated_records = #{updated}, pages_fetched = #{pages}, possibly_truncated = #{truncated}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE lease_token = #{token} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collector_monitor_cursor(task_id, last_success_at, last_pages_fetched, possibly_truncated) VALUES (#{id}, NOW(), #{pages}, #{truncated}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_success_at = VALUES(last_success_at), last_pages_fetched = VALUES(last_pages_fetched), possibly_truncated = VALUES(possibly_truncated)
